summary: Tested booking form Co-Applicant Gender field (with dynamic S/o, D/o, W/o label), backend BookingFormData accepting co_applicant_gender + co_applicant_date_of_birth, and new PUT /api/leads/{id}/reject endpoint (admin/manager). 6/6 backend pytest cases passed. Frontend e2e: co-applicant gender dynamic label works on /booking-form, Reject row button + confirmation dialog with reason + View-dialog Reject button + full flow (lead disappears, toast shows, unit released) all working.
critical_code_review_comments: LeadsPage.js is approaching 500 lines and mixes presentation + business logic; consider extracting LeadsTable, LeadViewDialog, RejectConfirmDialog into separate components per the >700 line guideline before further growth.

Reject endpoint deletes the customer hard via db.customers.delete_one — there is no audit trail/record of the rejected lead besides the activity log entry. Consider soft-delete (stage='rejected') so analytics/reporting can still see rejected leads + reason.
Backend reject endpoint accepts `reason` as a query param via request URL; per REST conventions a JSON body for PUT actions with side-data is preferable. Functionally works though.
BookingFormData & Customer correctly include co_applicant_gender / co_applicant_date_of_birth now — fix verified end-to-end.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend /api/units returns 0 units in this environment, so booking tests use synthetic unit data — booking submit handles missing unit gracefully (resolves fields from payload). The reject endpoint is documented in the task brief as /api/leads/{id}/reject (correct). The booking submit endpoint is /api/public/booking-form (NOT /api/booking/submit as the brief says).
